title: Nioh 3 is coming to Xbox on January 28, 2027 ⚔️
subject: nioh3
description:
Will you play Nioh 3 on Xbox? 👇

Koei Tecmo and Team Ninja announced that Nioh 3 and Nioh 3 Complete Edition launch on Xbox Series X|S on January 28, 2027, the first time the series comes to Xbox. The second and final DLC, Bloody Insurrection, arrives December 17, 2026, set in Shimabara in 1638. Game Pass inclusion has not been announced.

Sources: Koei Tecmo / Team Ninja announcement (Nov 2026), GamesRadar+ (Nov 24, 2026), Windows Central via WindowsForum (Nov 23-24, 2026)
Game footage © Koei Tecmo.

scenes.text: Nioh is finally coming to Xbox.
Koei Tecmo announced that Nioh 3 and its Complete Edition launch on Xbox Series X|S on January 28, 2027.
The series has stayed on PlayStation and PC since the first Nioh in 2017.
Nioh 3 itself launched on February 6 this year, on PS5 and Steam on the same day.
Before Xbox, the second and final DLC, Bloody Insurrection, lands December 17, set in Shimabara in 1638.
